subject: Reconnecting after missed discovery — two fast paths to rebook
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan@clearwave.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Quick discovery — confirm time?

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for signing up to take a look at Redwood. I booked a short 20-minute discovery for today at 3:30pm PT to walk through two things: your current inference costs and a quick demo of how our routing + cache profile could reduce latency for your customer-facing features.

If that slot still works, great — I’ll send a calendar invite. If not, two quick options: 1) pick a 15-min time on my calendar here: https://cal.redwood.com/kimberly/15 or 2) reply with 2-3 windows that work this week and I’ll match one.

Cc'ing Ben in case we want to surface any relevant docs ahead of time.

Best,
Kimberly Park
SDR, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: We missed you for today’s discovery — two quick paths to reconnect

Hi Jordan —

I didn’t see you join for the 3:30pm slot — hope everything’s OK. I know calendars get away from us, so wanted to offer two quick paths to reconnect depending on what’s easier for you:

Option A — 15-min rapid sync: grab a slot on my calendar and I’ll keep it short and focused: https://cal.redwood.com/kimberly/15

Option B — Self-serve review + on-demand demo: if you prefer to look first, I attached a one-pager and a proposed mutual action plan. If something looks interesting, reply with a few times and we’ll book a discovery.

If neither works, I can loop Ben in to coordinate a time that matches your ops/infra team. Whichever path is easiest for you.

Thanks,
Kim

--
Attachments: (stubs) Redwood-Intro-1pager.pdf, Proposed-MAP.xlsx

Hi Kim — apologies, I had an urgent call with a client and couldn’t make the 3:30 slot. Thanks for the follow-up and the materials.

I’m interested in a short call to understand how Redwood would slot into our multi-region inference setup. I’m in PT and have these windows this week:
- Wed 9/6 10:00–10:30am PT
- Thu 9/7 2:00–2:30pm PT

If those don’t work, I can also self-book via the link — appreciate the one-pager, could you also send a one-slide cost comparison if available?

Thanks,
Jordan Ellis
Product Lead — ClearWave
jordan@clearwave.io
